answer: Hey 👋 I'm Dan. Ask me about DansLab, Nervix.ai, YouTube Studio, Hermes, the agent fleet, OpenClaw, or how to get in touch.

I'm Dan Semenescu — founder of DansLab and Stack Finance LLC, based in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. I'm building a multi-agent AI architecture: a named fleet (David, Dexter, Nano, Memo, Sienna) plus Hermes — the most capable brain, paired with OpenClaw. Priorities: Nervix.ai (federation) and YouTube Studio (gateway).

DansLab is a multi-agent AI operating system. Each agent has a role, a personality, and a workspace — David (orchestrator), Dexter (backend), Nano (agent creator), Memo (PM), Sienna (crypto) — and Hermes, the most capable brain, paired hand-in-hand with the OpenClaw collective. The company's top priorities are Nervix.ai (the federation layer) and YouTube Studio (the gateway to growth). Everything runs over a Tailscale-linked fleet of machines under Stack Finance LLC.

Five named agents plus a brain. David (orchestrator on Mac Studio), Dexter (senior dev — NERVIX backend, CrawdBot, DevOps), Nano (agent creator — NERVIX enrollment), Memo (PM — MyWork framework, n8n), Sienna (crypto — ZmartyChat, trading). And Hermes — the most capable brain in the fleet — works hand-in-hand with the OpenClaw collective (KiloClaw, KimiClaw, ManusClaw).
David runs on the Mac Studio and orchestrates the fleet — task routing, coordination, lab-sync workflows. Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/david-workspace.
Dexter is the senior dev agent — owns NERVIX backend, CrawdBot, and DevOps. Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/dexter-workspace.
Memo is the PM agent — owns the MyWork framework and n8n automations. Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/memo-workspace.
Nano is the agent-creator agent — handles NERVIX enrollment and the agent factory itself. Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/nano-workspace.
Sienna runs the crypto vertical — ZmartyChat and the OpenClaw trading agents (Sienna Crypto Girl posts a 96.2% win rate). Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/sienna-workspace.

Hermes is the most capable brain in the DansLab fleet — the high-reasoning agent paired hand-in-hand with the OpenClaw collective. Where the named agents (David, Dexter, Nano, Memo, Sienna) own specific verticals, Hermes is the cross-cutting intelligence layer that backs OpenClaw decisions. Repo: github.com/DansiDanutz/hermes-agent — "the agent that grows with you".

Two priorities lead the company roadmap: (1) Nervix.ai — the agent federation layer, the #1 priority. (2) YouTube Studio — the gateway to company success, where DansLab meets the world. Everything else supports those two.

MyWork-AI is a Python framework: 67+ CLI commands for building, shipping, and selling software products. AI code gen, n8n automation, security scanning, marketplace. Install: pip install mywork-ai. Repo: github.com/DansiDanutz/MyWork-AI.
ZmartyChat is the AI crypto trading intelligence product — signals, analysis, alerts. Live at zmarty.vercel.app. Built and run by the Sienna agent stack with Hermes brain-power behind decisions.

OpenClaw is the agent collective — Red Lobster trading agents (Sienna Crypto Girl, 96.2% win rate) plus channel agents (KiloClaw, KimiClaw, ManusClaw). The whole collective is wired to Hermes, the most capable brain in the fleet. They work hand-in-hand. OpenClaw key-manager handles central API credentials.
SemeClaw is an internal agent framework I run as a sandbox — Python. github.com/DansiDanutz/SemeClaw. Most of the active priority work right now is in Nervix.ai and YouTube Studio.

Nervix.ai is the company's #1 priority — the agent federation layer. Every agent in the DansLab fleet enrolls through Nervix, gets credentials, and is observed from one place. It's the spine that lets a multi-agent company actually function. CLI: github.com/DansiDanutz/nervix-cli.

YouTube Studio is the company's gateway to success — the creator surface where DansLab meets the world. AI content generation, scenes, captions, thumbnails, distribution. Attention compounds into customers. Repo: github.com/DansiDanutz/Youtube-Studio.

YouTube is the company's gateway: YouTube Studio is the front door (AI content, scenes, captions, thumbnails) and YouTubePipeline is the OSS production engine (ComfyUI + Flux + Wan + Whisper + Remotion + ffmpeg). Together they're how DansLab compounds attention into customers.

Python 3.13 and TypeScript daily. Node.js 22, Docker. For AI: Claude Code (agentic runtime), n8n (automation), Anthropic + OpenAI APIs, Hermes for high-reasoning calls. For web: Next.js, React, Tailwind, Supabase, Vercel. Infra: Tailscale-linked fleet of 8 machines.
Claude Code is the runtime for every agent in DansLab. Sub-agents, hooks, skills, custom commands. David, Dexter, Memo, Nano, Sienna and Hermes all live on it.
Python 3.13 and TypeScript daily — Python for agent backends and CLIs, TS for web (Next.js).
Tailscale-linked fleet: mac-mini, mac-studio, memo-droplet, dexter-droplet, nano-droplet, sienna-droplet, dans-s24, and this laptop (seme). Each agent has a home machine.

Outside the laptop: family, Cluj, and whatever AI tool dropped this week. Also poker — hence PokerClubCluj.
